instruction: Move the opaque screen onto screen_pad, use the fixed inspection camera to inspect the label underneath, and report its actual code. Leave the label in place and the screen on its pad. The code is a fixed world fact, not a preference. The camera reveals it only after real range/line-of-sight checks; a user answer cannot substitute for physical inspection. No need to ask for a code that can be observed after clearing the screen. The user specifies inspection_code=alpha.
